_comment: Purchasable packs. Each adds depth to an axis the Starter pack only touches. Buying is never required to progress — only to have more to choose from.

pack.name: Around the House
pack.desc: Standing work. Nothing that needs a floor you'd be embarrassed to lie on.

movements.name: Lunge
movements.cue: Long step. Back knee toward the floor, not forward.

movements.name: Step-up
movements.cue: Bottom stair is fine. Whole foot on the step.

movements.name: Calf raise
movements.cue: Up slow, down slower. Hold the top for a beat.

pack.name: Floor Work
pack.desc: Holds instead of reps. Time is the unit, which changes how a set feels.

movements.name: Plank
movements.cue: Ribs down, hips level. Stop when the line breaks, not when it hurts.

movements.name: Glute bridge
movements.cue: Push through the heels. Squeeze at the top.

movements.name: Dead bug
movements.cue: Lower back stays glued to the floor. That's the whole exercise.

movements.name: Bird dog
movements.cue: Reach long, don't lift high.

pack.name: Out the Door
pack.desc: Movements that need shoes. These take real minutes, and the timer will hold you to them.

movements.name: Walk
scaling: To the end of the road and back
movements.cue: Out the door is the hard part. The rest is just walking.

movements.name: Stairs
movements.cue: Whole foot on each step. No hands if you can help it.

movements.name: Jog
movements.cue: Slower than you think. If you can't talk, you're racing.

pack.name: The Kitchen
pack.desc: Fuel as actions, never as numbers. Nothing here weighs anything.

movements.name: Eat some protein
movements.cue: Eggs, beans, fish, tofu, yoghurt. Whatever's actually in the house.

movements.name: Cook instead of ordering
movements.cue: Toast with something on it counts. The bar is low on purpose.

movements.name: Eat a piece of fruit
movements.cue: The one in the bowl that's about to go.

pack.name: Stillness
pack.desc: The hardest pack to start and the easiest to finish.

movements.name: Sit quietly
movements.cue: Not meditation. Just sitting, without a screen.

movements.name: Name three good things
movements.cue: Small ones count. Especially small ones.

movements.name: Stretch what hurts
movements.cue: Whatever's been complaining. Hold it, breathe, don't bounce.

pack.name: Nightfall
pack.desc: Sleep is a thing you do all evening, not a thing that happens to you at midnight.

movements.name: Wind down
movements.cue: Lights low, no feeds. Read something on paper if you have it.

movements.name: Screens away
movements.cue: Phone somewhere that isn't arm's reach of the bed.

movements.name: Make the room dark and cool
movements.cue: Curtains shut, window cracked. Two minutes of setup for eight hours of payoff.

pack.name: Company
pack.desc: The axis everyone forgets is a health axis.

movements.name: Call someone
movements.cue: Voice, not text. Five minutes is plenty.

movements.name: Walk with someone
movements.cue: Counts for Move as well. The only movement that does.

movements.name: Thank someone properly
movements.cue: Specific. Say what they did.

pack.name: Iron
pack.desc: Needs equipment. Bought last by most people, and that is the correct order.

movements.name: Row
movements.cue: Elbow past your ribs. Shoulder down and back.

movements.name: Overhead press
movements.cue: Ribs down. Press up, not forward.

movements.name: Loaded carry
movements.cue: Something heavy in each hand. Walk. Stand tall.
